description: Exact duration between two dates, plus business days.

faqs.a: The years/months/days breakdown walks the calendar forward from the start date (clamping the day to each month's length), so it matches how calendars actually work. Total days is the exact day count including leap days.
Business days count Monday-to-Friday only, excluding Saturdays and Sundays. Public holidays are not excluded — only weekends.
faqs.q: What counts as a business day?

faqs.a: Yes — the order is normalized automatically, so the result is always the positive duration between the two dates.
faqs.q: Does the order of the dates matter?

howto: Pick the start and end dates.
Tick the business-days option to count Mon–Fri too.
Read the years/months/days breakdown and totals.
Business days exclude Saturdays and Sundays only.
title: Date Duration Calculator
